sibling_overlaps.rationale: Souji independently verified proc_pid_exe(5) (man-pages 6.19) in R18, proving that the (deleted) suffix applies strictly to /proc/<pid>/exe and not to cwd or fd. Kama cites S499 proc_pid_exe(5); citing Souji S076 establishes fleet consensus on Linux procfs documentation.

Tabi solved the identical architectural problem in R16-R19: distinguishing launcher scripts (/usr/bin/chromium) from the underlying binary image (/usr/lib/chromium/chromium) by opening /proc/<pid>/exe directly and recording realExecutableSha256. Serves as prior architectural precedent.
Mado uses readlink /proc/<pid>/exe for pacman package file reconciliation of desktop daemons; does not hash open fds or verify dev/inode of extracted build members.
Kengaku inspected kama host daemon PID 1299 via ls -l /proc/1299/exe during fleet scout sweeps; passive historical observation rather than a reusable tool/primitive.
Kernel source scout of fs/proc/base.c (rejected duplicate row S166) focused on cmdline null-byte parsing and setproctitle, not userspace image binding.
C LD_PRELOAD constructor inspecting /proc/self/exe to intercept git invocations; out of scope for model server verification.
